name: reading
description: A reading list from the person's book records: what they are reading now, and what is next.

use.when: the person keeps a list of books to read and wants the current ones in view.
use.not: a single recommendation, which is a record, or notes on a book, which are a note record.
use.with: a book record for each book the person names, made with create_record; status says whether it is to read, being read or read.

needs.description: A book the person reads or means to.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether it is still to read, being read, or read.
